Catalog.title: Catalog
Catalog.description: Serializable immutable catalog snapshot consumed by API/UI layers.

DataRequirement.title: DataRequirement
DataRequirement.description: One enabled signal dependency resolved to a normalized data source.

DataSettings.title: DataSettings
DataSettings.description:
Validated data policy frozen with each run's settings.

Defaults and parameter-catalog range validation are materialized at the
catalog/config boundary; domain contracts do not depend on the catalog.

Diagnostic.title: Diagnostic
Diagnostic.description: A structured reason that can be rendered through a translation key.

DiagnosticCode.title: DiagnosticCode
DiagnosticCode.description: Machine-readable diagnostics; localized text belongs to the UI dictionary.

FrozenRunConfig.title: FrozenRunConfig
FrozenRunConfig.description: Immutable copy of shared settings and all strategy drafts.

FrozenStrategyInstance.title: FrozenStrategyInstance
FrozenStrategyInstance.description: Immutable strategy copy stored inside a run snapshot.

ParameterDefinition.title: ParameterDefinition
ParameterDefinition.description:
Metadata and validation hints for one stable configuration key.

The catalog deliberately stores metadata, not executable strategy logic.  A
consumer can render an editor, validate a candidate, and enumerate search
dimensions from this one object.  ``default`` is intentionally JSON-like so
that dates, decimals, and list defaults can be serialized without a second
frontend schema.

ParameterGroupDefinition.title: ParameterGroupDefinition
ParameterGroupDefinition.description: Localized display metadata for one stable family of form fields.

ParameterLevel.title: ParameterLevel
ParameterLevel.description: Where a parameter is edited in the run model.

ParameterType.title: ParameterType
ParameterType.description: Allowed input/value shapes exposed by the catalog contract.

PresetDefinition.title: PresetDefinition
PresetDefinition.description: Catalog metadata for one strategy type.

ResultRole.title: ResultRole
ResultRole.description: Whether a result is an automatic benchmark or a user strategy.

RunDataContext.title: RunDataContext
RunDataContext.description: Data identity and resolved range, available only after the worker loads data.

RunDataProvenance.title: RunDataProvenance
RunDataProvenance.description: Stable source and coverage markers frozen with a submitted run.

RunDateAdjustment.title: RunDateAdjustment
RunDateAdjustment.description: A verified date resolution recorded after the submitted config is frozen.

RunProgressEvent.title: RunProgressEvent
RunProgressEvent.description: JSON data inside an SSE frame; states are the same as full run responses.

RunResponse.title: RunResponse
RunResponse.description: Current status, progress, immutable inputs, and saved results.

RunResult.title: RunResult
RunResult.description: Saved result collection, including partial success across strategies.

RunSnapshot.title: RunSnapshot
RunSnapshot.description: The immutable input boundary for one submitted run.

RunStrategySummary.title: RunStrategySummary
RunStrategySummary.description: A terminal strategy's saved metrics and diagnostics in a small event.

SearchCandidate.title: SearchCandidate
SearchCandidate.description: One stable candidate result, including invalid or unavailable rows.

SearchDimension.title: SearchDimension
SearchDimension.description: A grid dimension whose key points to a normal parameter definition.

SearchPeriod.title: SearchPeriod
SearchPeriod.description: Saved independent evaluation window, including actual session coverage.

SearchResult.title: SearchResult
SearchResult.description: Complete candidate set and stable ranking for one search strategy.

SearchResultDimension.title: SearchResultDimension
SearchResultDimension.description: A stable search axis captured with its persisted candidate results.

SearchTestResult.title: SearchTestResult
SearchTestResult.description: Test summary references its own saved detail; never participates in ranking.

SharedSettings.title: SharedSettings
SharedSettings.description: Settings shared by every strategy and automatic benchmark.

SignalState.title: SignalState
SignalState.description: Three-valued state for every enabled daily signal dependency.

StrategyPresetId.title: StrategyPresetId
StrategyPresetId.description: Stable strategy catalog identifiers, including fixed condition templates.

StrategyRun.title: StrategyRun
StrategyRun.description: One strategy result; zero trades is valid when metrics are complete.

StrategyStatus.title: StrategyStatus
StrategyStatus.description: Statuses emitted for a job and for each strategy result.

StrategyValidationResult.title: StrategyValidationResult
StrategyValidationResult.description: Independent validation outcome so unused strategies cannot block a run.

TechnicalIndicatorSeries.title: TechnicalIndicatorSeries
TechnicalIndicatorSeries.description: Exact signal-cache values; null samples retain explicit warmup/gaps.

UnexecutedSignal.title: UnexecutedSignal
UnexecutedSignal.description: A true close signal with no later session inside the requested run.
